I've been coming to Tiendanimal Glòries with my dog, Milky, for quite some time now. I'm a regular customer; I usually buy something every time I come, and I also volunteer when animal rescue organizations are holding collections or campaigns in the store. They've always treated us very well, and my dog ​​knows that when he gets to the checkout, he usually gets one of the treats they have on the counter.

Today we discovered that, apparently, the treat has new terms and conditions. 😅

Lara, an employee I hadn't seen before, helped us and asked me to write a Google review in exchange for a treat for the dog. I told her I didn't have time to do it right then, but that I would later. Her response: "It has to be now, or he doesn't get a treat."

And sure enough, he didn't get one. 😂

Obviously, I completely understand that the store isn't obligated to give treats to dogs. Of course not. What I find quite awful is that something that all the employees had previously treated as a friendly gesture suddenly became a bargaining chip for getting a Google review, and they even demanded it be done right then and there.

Well, Lara, I said I'd post the review later. Here it is. 😅

And it really bothers me to write this because I'm not one to leave negative reviews, and until today I'd always had very good experiences here.

I'm giving it 2 stars, and the second one is precisely because of the rest of the team and the great service we've always received.

It's a shame that such an unnecessary gesture makes you not want to return to a place you've been going to for a long time with pleasure.
